question.problem:
Consider the bilinear form $B(x,y),$ given by 

$$
B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}.
$$

 

Evaluate $B(x,y)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\,$ $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =1\cdot 3+1\cdot 3+2\cdot 1\cdot (-1)+1\cdot (-1) \\  & =3+3-2-1 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
